description: Grade a page's draft on the four pillars (answers the search, says something new, can be trusted, easy to quote): overall 0 to 100, each pillar's verdict, and the checklist: what to fix, by name, and for each pillar under 80 what would raise it. Write, score, clear the checklist, score again. 25 per day.
name: score_page
title: Score a page
